# Abstract

This study investigates compound growth using a
simplified financial model.

The purpose of the study is to demonstrate the
time value of money and validate expected model
behavior under controlled assumptions.

# Introduction

Compound growth is one of the most important
concepts in finance.

A small initial investment can grow substantially
when returns are reinvested over long periods of
time.

This study demonstrates compound growth using a
minimal retirement-planning scenario.

# Study Goals

This study was designed to:

* Demonstrate compound growth.
* Illustrate the time value of money.
* Validate expected model behavior.
* Serve as a reference example for ROOST.
